decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings fit the firm's core drainage families and have their own page, so a first-year product with no evidence of a shortfall gives no cause for problemistic search.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's stated direction toward accessible, low-profile systems, so it meets aspirations strategically and the slack of an established firm can carry it.
As the flagship designer product it embodies the firm's design-quality positioning, and management would not drop it after one year without clear negative feedback.
The shower element with integrated slope complements the floor-level drainage system for renovations, and its uncertain early results can be absorbed by organisational slack.
The backflow-protected basement drain was actively promoted as a specific development and addresses a clear safety need, so there is no sign of performance falling below aspiration.

The air-admittance valve is more peripheral to the bathroom-design focus and only mentioned on the website, but it is a low-cost complementary line within the drainage range with no evidence of a shortfall.
